description: Upgrade a SwOS switch's firmware the way the web UI's Upgrade tab does. Resolves the latest stable version for the model from MikroTik's download server (or takes `version`), downloads swos-<board>-<version>.bin over HTTPS into the server's SwOS folder (or uses `file`), checks it, then flashes it; the switch reboots. Refuses release candidates unless allowPrerelease is true. A switch still on its preinstalled backup firmware (a version ending in 'p', which cannot save configuration) counts as needing the upgrade. dryRun defaults to true.

allowPrerelease.description: Allow a release candidate or beta version.

board.description: Firmware board name, e.g. css318g. Derived from the model when omitted.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dryRun.description: Resolve, download and check the firmware without flashing it.

file.description: Use this firmware file from the server's SwOS folder instead of downloading one (offline upgrade).

force.description: Flash a `board` that differs from the one derived from the switch's model.

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

version.description: Target version. Defaults to the latest stable release for this model.

name: upgrade_swos_firmware
title: Upgrade SwOS Firmware
